errors.evidence: The description omits the subject of the chart, which is the dynamics of Foreign Direct Investment (FDI) in Bulgaria, as indicated by the caption "Динамика ПЧИ в България 2018-2022".

The estimated range for the value in 2021 is incorrect. The line passes below the midpoint of the 4,600,000 and 4,800,000 gridlines, making the value less than 4,700,000 (approximately 4,680,000). The provided range of 4,700,000–4,750,000 is an overestimation.
